blocks.title: Non-conservative force
blocks.text: Woh force non-conservative hai jis ka do points ke darmiyan, ya band raste par, cheez le jane ka work raste (path) par depend kare.

Kinetic friction (ragar) ki force non-conservative hai. Jab cheez kisi surface (satah) par phisalti hai to kinetic friction motion (harkat) ke ulat lagti hai aur negative work karti hai, jis ka magnitude = friction force × raste ki lambai. Is liye do points ke darmiyan lamba rasta ho to zyada work hota hai, yani work raste par depend karta hai. Aur band raste par non-conservative force ka kul work zero nahi hota.
Non-conservative force ki aur misalein: hawa ki rukawat (air resistance), dhaage (string) mein tension, normal force aur rocket ki propulsion (aage dhakelne wali) force.

blocks.prompt: 2 kg ki cheez 5 m oopar phenki jati hai aur wapas aa jati hai. Oopar jate waqt, neeche aate waqt aur kul milakar gravity ka work nikalein (numerical problem 4.6). Friction ke khilaf work non-conservative kyun hai (constructed response 4.6)?
blocks.explanation: Oopar jate waqt displacement gravity ke ulat hai: W = −mgh = −2 × 9.8 × 5 = −98 J. Neeche aate waqt +98 J. Kul 0 J, yani band raste par gravity ka work zero hai, jaisa conservative force mein hona chahiye. Friction hamesha motion ke ulat hoti hai, is liye har hisse par us ka work negative hai; band raste par yeh cancel nahi hota balke jama hota jata hai, aur lamba rasta zyada work leta hai. Is liye friction ka work raste par depend karta hai.

items: Gravitational field: Zameen ke ird-gird ki jagah jahan gravity lagti hai. A se B tak kisi bhi raste (ADB, ACB, mura hua) par gravity ka work −mgh; band raste par zero: yeh conservative force hai (gravity, electrostatic, spring).
Non-conservative: work raste par depend kare aur band raste par zero na ho: kinetic friction, air resistance, tension, normal force, rocket propulsion.
